Cc: NovaFin Security <security@novafin.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Pen test report and hosting coverage for SOC 2 evidence request

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for taking our SOC 2 evidence request earlier this week. Our security team is compiling the control pack and they asked for a copy of the most recent penetration test report and a short clarification on which hosting variants were covered by that test. Specifically:

- Does the report include Redwood Hosted (multi-tenant) endpoints?
- Are Redwood Dedicated (customer-dedicated GPU pools) included?
- For Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem), do we get any coverage or is that explicitly out-of-scope?

We need a short written statement we can attach to the SOC 2 documentation that explains coverage and any exclusions (for example, third-party cloud provider components, customer-managed networks, KMS keys). If you can also point us to any supplemental artifacts (asset lists, remediation tracker) that would be helpful.

Would appreciate a response by EOD Tuesday (Dec 1) to keep our audit timeline.

Best,
Maria

Maria Gonzalez
Head of Security Operations, NovaFin
security@novafin.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pen test report and hosting coverage for SOC 2 evidence request

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear list of asks. Short answer up front: the latest internal penetration test covers Hosted and Dedicated service surfaces; Private/VPC and on-prem customer-managed deployments are out of scope for that engagement.

Summary (bullet):
- Covered: Redwood Hosted API endpoints (multi-tenant control plane and data plane paths we operate) and Redwood Dedicated GPU pools when served by our managed control plane.
- Not covered: Customer-managed Private deployments (VPC, on-prem packages) where the customer controls the network, KMS, or physical hardware.
- Rationale: The pen test was scoped to assets we operate and patch (control plane, managed runtime, and infra components). For Dedicated, we included managed pools and network egress interfaces; for Private, the test would require customer authorization and a separate engagement.

Im attaching the redacted summary and an asset export that maps hostnames and service roles. Laura — can you confirm if we should add the remediation tracker link for NovaFin? Karthik — please flag any Dedicated-specific caveats we should call out (e.g., third-party marketplace images or partner-managed ORchestration).

Next steps:
- I will follow up with a one-page statement you can attach to your SOC 2 pack.
- If NovaFin wants Private/VPC included, we can propose a scoped pen test with SOW and timeline.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Head of Security Partnerships (acting), Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@novafin.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:26:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pen test report and hosting coverage for SOC 2 evidence request

Maria — quick technical clarifications to help you validate the statement against controls:  

- Hosted: the test included control-plane API endpoints, tenant routing, token issuance flows, and common runtime components (inference runtime, KV cache endpoints). We did NOT include external marketplace images used by a small subset of Dedicated customers.
- Dedicated: tests included dedicated GPU pools that are under Redwood-managed orchestration (we list their pool ids in the asset CSV). If a Dedicated deployment has been self-hosted or integrated with a third-party orchestration layer controlled by the customer, that instance was excluded.
- Private/VPC/on-prem: explicitly excluded — the assets are in the customer's VPC and the customer holds KMS keys and firewall controls. Any evidence for that environment must come from the customer or from a joint scoped engagement where the customer grants testers access.

Also: remediation status — we tracked high/medium findings in the attached tracker. All critical findings from the last test were resolved as of 2026-10-10; medium items have remediation owner and ETA in the tracker. Monica — please confirm the public-facing remediation statement is ok to share.

Karthik
Director, Applied Security, Redwood Inference

-- BEGIN ATTACHABLE STATEMENT --
Redwood Inference penetration testing coverage statement (redacted)
Date: 2026-11-01

Scope: The referenced penetration test was conducted against Redwood-operated assets: (1) Redwood Hosted API endpoints and supporting control plane services; (2) Redwood Dedicated GPU pools when managed by Redwood's orchestration layer.

Exclusions: Customer-managed Private deployments (VPC or on-prem installations), customer-managed KMS keys, and any third-party components controlled directly by customers were excluded from the engagement and are the responsibility of the customer to provide evidence for.

Remediation: Critical issues identified in the engagement were remediated prior to report publication. A sanitized remediation tracker and asset export has been provided to the NovaFin security team.

-- END ATTACHABLE STATEMENT --

Let me know if this meets your needs and I can mark this thread resolved.

Thanks,
